events.quote: Nemtsov was among the 34 original signatories of the online anti-Putin manifesto Putin must go , published on 10 March 2010 .

events.text: Nemtsov formed the For Russia without Lawlessness and Corruption party with Vladimir Ryzhkov, Mikhail Kasyanov and Vladimir Milov.
events.subject: self
events.object: For Russia without Lawlessness and Corruption party
events.quote: in September 2010 , together with Vladimir Ryzhkov , Mikhail Kasyanov and Vladimir Milov , Nemtsov formed the For Russia without Lawlessness and Corruption party

events.text: The party was transformed into the Peoples Freedom Party.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: which , three months later was transformed into the Peoples Freedom Party

events.text: The party submitted an application for registration to the Ministry of Justice.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In May 2011 , the party submitted an application for registration to the Ministry of Justice

events.text: The application for registration was denied.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: but one month later it was denied
